g.text: Exactly one SPF record was found and no issues were detected by TraceDNS's basic checks.
Includes and redirects are not followed, so this is not a full SPF evaluation.
Exactly one DMARC record was found with a valid version and policy. This is a basic syntax and
policy check against RFC 9989, not a full DMARC conformance test.
DMARC aggregate reporting is not configured
There is no 'rua=' tag, so you will not receive aggregate reports showing which sources send
DKIM check skipped: no selector supplied
DKIM selectors cannot be reliably discovered from DNS, so TraceDNS only checks DKIM for a
